name: Quenten Higgan
story: Quenten Higgan worked with AsureQuality’s AgriBase, a national spatial database of farms and rural properties, and later in biosecurity surveillance and innovation. His 2019 New Zealand Esri User Conference presentation on the Queensland fruit-fly response won the conference best-presenter award. His work links maintained rural spatial data with operational biosecurity response.
